verdicts.reason: A keeps one clean left margin: the quote mark, headline, attribution and logo all line up, and the can and circle sit bottom-right as in the original. Its flaws are the orphaned word 'soon.' on the last headline line, a can that has shrunk to minor importance, and some empty space in the middle. B's left edges don't line up (quote mark about x55, headline about x27, attribution and logo about x50), and the headline is pushed tight to the left edge of the canvas. Its attribution touches the top of the circle and the logo sits on the circle, so the grouping looks accidental.
